# PLAN — iteration 4
## Current state assessment
The incumbent uses 7 LUTs and meets setup and hold timing, so this iteration must strictly reduce LUT use to qualify. The three prior candidates were rejected: the 8-bit counter used 10 LUTs, the comparator rewrite stayed at 7, and split counters used 9. The top latency is unknown; no numeric annotation is required.

## Hypothesis
Expressing the unsigned comparison as a subtract carry-out may let Vivado map it with fewer LUTs while preserving the registered PWM output and counter behavior.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the 32-bit counter, its rollover branch, and reset logic unchanged. Replace only the PWM comparison with an explicitly sized 9-bit subtraction of the zero-extended 8-bit counter and duty, deriving `pwm_out` from the carry/borrow bit so the result remains true exactly when `counter[7:0] < duty`. Preserve the existing nonblocking output register update and verify the result against the frozen testbench and routed LUT, WNS, and WHS reports.
